clouds-beginner.title: Clouds - Beginner’s Guide to Drawing & Painting Clouds
clouds-beginner.blurb: Beginner’s Guide to Drawing & Painting Clouds is a structured online masterclass thoughtfully designed for aspiring artists and beginners. Featuring high-definition video demonstration lessons, this course comes with clear English voiceovers and subtitles, making your learning experience seamless and accessible. The curriculum follows an intuitive step-by-step progression, starting from foundational pencil sketching and simple perspective principles to help you grasp the three-dimensional volume of clouds. You will dive into a systematic breakdown of line work, composition, light and shadow placement, colour mixing, and essential water control. As you move into watercolour painting, you will master the medium’s core techniques, including flat washes, colour blending, wet-on-wet, dry-on-dry, and negative space painting. Whether you are picking up a paintbrush for the very first time or seeking to enhance the atmospheric depth of your artwork, this course will empower you to capture the fleeting beauty of skies and clouds with total technical confidence.
learn: Simplify fluffy cloud contours in pencil and hatch them into three-dimensional form
Arrange clouds on a perspective grid so the sky reads with real foreground-to-horizon depth
Mix colour and control your water — flat washes, graded washes, wet-on-wet and dry-on-dry
Guard the whites with negative space painting and carry the atmosphere of a real sky
who: Complete beginners
No drawing experience assumed — the first lesson starts at the shopping list.
Photo copiers
You can copy a reference but cannot invent a sky from nothing.
Flat-sky painters
Your clouds keep going flat, grey or muddy and you cannot see why.

lessons.title: Introduction to drawing clouds
lessons.subtitle: Crystal has supplied the film; the description is still to come.

lessons.title: Pencil cloud form & basic hatching
lessons.subtitle: Simplify fluffy cloud contours in pencil, then hatch to set light, shadow and first volume.
lessons.focus: Learn to use pencil lines to simplify fluffy cloud contours and apply basic hatching to establish light, shadow, and initial 3D volume.
lessons.tools: Sketching pencils, curved contouring, parallel and cross-hatching.
lessons.outcome: Master cloud structure observation, create quick, fluid rough sketches, and establish clear basic light and shadow values.

lessons.title: Marker perspective grid & spatial depth
lessons.subtitle: Arrange clouds from foreground to horizon on a perspective grid, varying stroke weight for depth.
lessons.focus: Use perspective grid lines to arrange clouds from foreground to horizon, using varied marker stroke weights to create strong spatial depth.
lessons.tools: Markers / fine-liners, perspective grid lines, line weight dynamics, spatial perspective.
lessons.outcome: Understand sky perspective principles, master foreground-to-background scale rules, and construct crisp marker compositions with expansive depth.

lessons.title: Detailed graphite shading & soft edges
lessons.subtitle: Understand the concepts of sketching and use deep shadows and subtle tonal gradations to transform flat outlines into three-dimensional cloud forms.
lessons.focus: Deconstruct complex cumulus clouds into simple spherical units and establish basic shading with pencil hatching. Render hyper-realistic cloud textures and high-contrast volumetric light using graphite pencils and kneaded erasers.
lessons.tools: A detailed sketching lesson covering fundamental geometric concepts. You will explore tonal values — from highlights and mid-tones to shadows — and the interplay of space, light and shadow, while learning step by step how to render abstract cloud formations.
lessons.outcome: Understand the concepts of sketching and use deep shadows and subtle tonal gradations to transform flat outlines into three-dimensional cloud forms.

lessons.title: Marker block-in & value distribution
lessons.subtitle: Dual-tone markers block sky and cloud shadow fast, so composition is planned before paint.
lessons.focus: Use dual-tone markers to quickly block in sky and cloud shadows, strengthening your sense of light values.
lessons.outcome: Master fast value-study techniques to plan composition and light intensity before painting.

lessons.title: Perfect sky gradient & water control
lessons.subtitle: Control the water-to-paint ratio for smooth, brushstroke-free sky gradients — no backruns.
lessons.focus: Control water-to-paint ratios to create smooth, brushstroke-free sky background gradients.
lessons.tools: Flat / round watercolour brushes, graded wash technique.
lessons.outcome: Master seamless colour transitions from dark blue to soft sunset hues without backruns or hard lines.

lessons.title: Cloud volume, light & layered shading
lessons.subtitle: Warm sunset light against cool purple-grey shadow, built up in multiple washes.
lessons.focus: Explore contrast using warm light (sunset yellow) and cool shadows (purple-grey) through multi-layered washes to create rich cloud volume.
lessons.tools: Round watercolour brushes, colour blending, combined wet-on-wet and wet-on-dry techniques.
lessons.outcome: Learn to represent light and shadow with distinct colour temperatures, master pigment-to-water ratios, and render three-dimensional clouds with warm sunlight.

lessons.title: Reserved whites & flat-wash cloud studies
lessons.subtitle: Two studies on one sheet: hard-edged whites left unpainted, cool flat washes laid around them.

lessons.title: Soft-edged cumulus on a deep blue sky
lessons.subtitle: Building a saturated blue behind billowing whites, keeping every edge soft.

lessons.title: A dark cloud bank over a warm horizon
lessons.subtitle: Cool storm greys above, warm ochre and orange below — two temperatures in one sky.

lessons.title: Lifting & softening a single cloud
lessons.subtitle: Working back into a damp wash with a clean brush to shape one cloud from the sky itself.

lessons.title: Towering cumulus in layered greys
lessons.subtitle: Stacked grey-violet washes against deep blue, with the sunlit faces reserved.

lessons.title: A broken sky of scattered cloud
lessons.subtitle: Many small forms at once — reserved whites, grey undersides, and blue holes between them.

clouds-intermediate.title: Clouds - Intermediate Guide to Drawing & Painting Clouds
clouds-intermediate.blurb: The techniques that separate a study from a painting. Wet-on-wet edges, gradient washes, guarded whites — then three full scenes where all of it runs at once.
learn: Time a wet-on-wet edge by the shine on the paper, not by fiddling
Lay a smooth gradient wash that a cloud can actually sit on
Plan and guard your whites instead of rescuing them later
Take a sky from reference to finished scene on your own
who: Beginner graduates
You have finished the Beginner course and want control, not luck.
Comfortable with washes

Scene painters

freeVideos._note: Every record carries `host`. "drive" means the film is one of the .MOV/.mp4 files under assets/05 - Free Videos/, uploaded to Google Drive and keyed by source filename in tools/video-links.json. "youtube" means Crystal supplied a link rather than a file: the id is in `youtubeId` and `watch` is her own URL, transcribed character-for-character from assets/05 - Free Videos/LinkofShorts_FreeVideo.docx (2026-08-16). A YouTube record has NO entry in tools/asset-manifest.json - there is no local file to probe - so it has no duration and no local poster, and tools/build-data.py does not yet emit it: it must learn `host`/`youtubeId`/`watch` and must iterate this map, not only the manifest. `desc` is deliberately empty on every YouTube record: Crystal supplied a title and a link and nothing else, and a blurb written here would be invented.

mountain.title: Mountains in watercolour
mountain.desc: A full mountain study, wet-on-wet from the sky down — the same value thinking as the cloud course, applied to rock.

pink-floral.title: Loose pink florals
pink-floral.desc: Petals in three strokes. A short, forgiving demo for anyone nervous about painting flowers.

watercolor-airport.title: Watercolour airport sketch
watercolor-airport.desc: An on-location sketch from an airport window — line and wash, thirty minutes, nothing precious.
